source.check: Original citation restored 6 Nov 2026 (the 5 Nov verification had moved it because of a text-cleaning fault).

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Nominations were received by the clerk, Mr. J. L. Rankin, on 5 May 1936. No division was contested; all the nominees were returned unopposed. Polling in County Tyrone was fixed for Wednesday 3 June 1936 (Strabane Chronicle, 21 March 1936, p. 4; Belfast News-Letter, 17 March 1936, p. 12); no poll was needed where all seats were filled at nominations. Filed on 1936-06-03, the Tyrone polling day (previously filed under 1936-05-28, 6 Nov 2026). Two seats; Miss Mayne is a J.P. Returned unopposed.
